en-US.description: Upload model images, choose a background, and generate fashion scene swap visuals.
en-US.error.noModels: No AI model is currently available
en-US.error.noSize: The current model does not provide a usable size preset
en-US.error.referenceLimit: The reference image limit for the current model has been reached
en-US.error.references: The uploaded images do not contain usable reference identifiers
en-US.help.backgroundImage: AI will extract the reference image's background style, spatial structure, lighting, and color tone, then blend it into the model image.
en-US.help.backgroundPrompt: More specific descriptions work better, such as space type, lighting, color tone, depth of field, and commercial mood.
en-US.label: Scene Swap
en-US.placeholder.backgroundPrompt: Enter a background description, such as luxury fashion campaign studio set, warm storefront lighting, cinematic city street at night...
en-US.upload.modelImageTip: Upload model images. Clear subjects and stable poses improve the scene swap result.

zh-CN.description: 上传模特图，选择背景方式，一键生成模拍换景效果图。
zh-CN.error.noModels: 暂无可用 AI 模型
zh-CN.error.noSize: 当前模型缺少可用尺寸配置
zh-CN.error.referenceLimit: 参考图数量已达当前模型上限
zh-CN.error.references: 图片缺少可用于生成的资源标识
zh-CN.help.backgroundImage: AI 将提取参考图的背景风格、空间结构、光线和色调，融合至模特图中。
zh-CN.help.backgroundPrompt: 描述越具体效果越好，例如空间类型、光线、色调、景深和商业氛围。
zh-CN.label: 模拍换景
zh-CN.placeholder.backgroundPrompt: 输入背景描述内容，如：高级服装广告棚景，暖色调橱窗光，城市街道夜景...
zh-CN.upload.backgroundImage: 上传 / 拖拽背景参考图
zh-CN.upload.modelImageTip: 支持上传多张模特图，建议主体清晰、姿态稳定，便于换景生成。
